subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I feel stiff if I spend too long sitting down.
portuguese: Fico preso se passo demasiado tempo sentado.
pronunciationNote: FEE-koo PREH-zoo s PAH-soo deh-mah-ZYAH-doo TEM-poo sen-TAH-doo
notes: Useful for talking about sedentary habits.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando trabalho muitas horas seguidas, fico preso se passo demasiado tempo sentado.
exampleSentences.english: When I work many hours in a row, I feel stiff if I spend too long sitting down.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I recover better when I sleep enough.
portuguese: Recupero melhor quando durmo o suficiente.
pronunciationNote: rreh-koo-PEH-roo meh-LYOR KWAN-doo DOOR-moo oo soo-fee-see-EN-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo depois de treinar, recupero melhor quando durmo o suficiente.
exampleSentences.english: Even after training, I recover better when I sleep enough.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: If I do not move during the day, I end up feeling sluggish.
portuguese: Se não me mexo durante o dia, acabo por me sentir sem energia.
pronunciationNote: s nown m MEH-shoo door-AN-t oo DEE-ah, ah-KAH-boo poor m sen-TEER seng eh-nehr-ZHEE-ah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nos dias em que fico em casa, se não me mexo durante o dia, acabo por me sentir sem energia.
exampleSentences.english: On the days when I stay at home, if I do not move during the day, I end up feeling sluggish.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am trying to find a routine that I can actually stick to.
portuguese: Estou a tentar encontrar uma rotina que eu consiga mesmo manter.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR en-kon-TRAR OO-mah rroh-TEE-nah k eh-oo kon-SEE-gah MAY-zmoo man-TAIR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de planos exagerados, estou a tentar encontrar uma rotina que eu consiga mesmo manter.
exampleSentences.english: Instead of exaggerated plans, I am trying to find a routine that I can actually stick to.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I push myself too hard at first and then lose momentum.
portuguese: No início puxo demasiado por mim e depois perco o ritmo.
pronunciationNote: noo ee-NEE-see-oo POO-shoo deh-mah-ZYAH-doo poor meeng ee deh-POYSH PAIR-koo oo REET-moo
notes: Useful for describing an inconsistent pattern.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando começo motivado, no início puxo demasiado por mim e depois perco o ritmo.
exampleSentences.english: When I start motivated, I push myself too hard at first and then lose momentum.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I need exercise that helps me clear my head as well.
portuguese: Preciso de exercício que me ajude também a desanuviar.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d eh-zehr-SEE-see-oo k m ah-ZHOO-dah tamb-AYNG ah deh-zah-noo-vee-AR
notes: Useful for linking physical and mental wellbeing.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não procuro só resultados físicos; preciso de exercício que me ajude também a desanuviar.
exampleSentences.english: I am not only looking for physical results; I need exercise that helps me clear my head as well.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I notice the difference when I am consistent for a few weeks.
portuguese: Noto a diferença quando sou consistente durante algumas semanas.
pronunciationNote: NOH-too ah dee-feh-REN-sah KWAN-doo soh kon-seesh-TEN-t door-AN-t al-GOO-mash seh-MAH-nash
notes: Useful for talking about medium-term habits.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo que o progresso seja lento, noto a diferença quando sou consistente durante algumas semanas.
exampleSentences.english: Even if progress is slow, I notice the difference when I am consistent for a few weeks.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I would rather train less often and recover properly.
portuguese: Preferia treinar menos vezes e recuperar em condições.
pronunciationNote: preh-feh-REE-ah trey-NAR MEN-oosh VAY-zesh ee rreh-koo-peh-RAR eng kon-dee-SOYNH

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de exagerar, preferia treinar menos vezes e recuperar em condições.
exampleSentences.english: Instead of overdoing it, I would rather train less often and recover properly.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: My shoulders get tight when I am stressed.
portuguese: Os ombros ficam tensos quando estou stressado.
pronunciationNote: ooz OM-broosh FEE-kang TEN-soosh KWAN-doo esh-TOH streh-SAH-doo
notes: Useful for linking stress and the body.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quase sempre, os ombros ficam tensos quando estou stressado.
exampleSentences.english: Almost always, my shoulders get tight when I am stressed.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I have to remind myself to slow down and breathe.
portuguese: Tenho de me lembrar de abrandar e respirar.
pronunciationNote: TEN-yoo d m lemb-RAR d ah-bran-DAR ee rresh-pee-RAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando tudo se acumula, tenho de me lembrar de abrandar e respirar.
exampleSentences.english: When everything piles up, I have to remind myself to slow down and breathe.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: What I need most is a routine that feels manageable.
portuguese: O que mais preciso é de uma rotina que pareça gerível.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh preh-SEE-zoo eh d OO-mah rroh-TEE-nah k pah-REH-sah zheh-REE-vel

exampleSentences.portuguese: Neste momento, o que mais preciso é de uma rotina que pareça gerível.
exampleSentences.english: At the moment, what I need most is a routine that feels manageable.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I can tell when I am run down because even simple things feel harder.
portuguese: Percebo quando estou em baixo porque até as coisas simples custam mais.
pronunciationNote: pehr-SEH-boo KWAN-doo esh-TOH eng BAI-shoo por-k ah-TAY az KOY-zash SEEM-plesh KOOSH-tang mysh
notes: Useful for describing low energy periods.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando não descanso bem, percebo quando estou em baixo porque até as coisas simples custam mais.
exampleSentences.english: When I do not rest well, I can tell when I am run down because even simple things feel harder.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am trying to pay more attention to recovery, not just performance.
portuguese: Estou a tentar dar mais atenção à recuperação, e não apenas ao desempenho.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR dar mysh ah-ten-SOWN ah rreh-koo-peh-rah-SOWN, ee nown ah-peh-NASH ow deh-sem-PEN-yoo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nos últimos meses, estou a tentar dar mais atenção à recuperação, e não apenas ao desempenho.
exampleSentences.english: In recent months, I am trying to pay more attention to recovery, not just performance.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: A short walk usually helps me reset mentally.
portuguese: Uma caminhada curta costuma ajudar-me a resetar mentalmente.
pronunciationNote: OO-mah kah-mee-NYAH-dah KOOR-tah koosh-TOO-mah ah-zhoo-DAR-m ah rreh-zeh-TAR men-tal-MEN-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando fico saturado, uma caminhada curta costuma ajudar-me a resetar mentalmente.
exampleSentences.english: When I feel saturated, a short walk usually helps me reset mentally.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I need exercise that fits around my day rather than disrupts it.
portuguese: Preciso de exercício que se encaixe no meu dia em vez de o complicar.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d eh-zehr-SEE-see-oo k s en-KAI-she noo may-oo DEE-ah eng vesh d oo kom-plee-KAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Com a rotina que tenho, preciso de exercício que se encaixe no meu dia em vez de o complicar.
exampleSentences.english: With the routine I have, I need exercise that fits around my day rather than disrupts it.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: If I am overtired, training harder usually backfires.
portuguese: Se estiver demasiado cansado, treinar mais forte costuma sair ao contrário.
pronunciationNote: s esh-TEE-ver deh-mah-ZYAH-doo kan-SAH-doo, trey-NAR mysh FOR-t koosh-TOO-mah sah-EER ow kon-TRAH-ree-oo
notes: Useful for talking about recovery limits.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Já percebi que, se estiver demasiado cansado, treinar mais forte costuma sair ao contrário.
exampleSentences.english: I have already realised that if I am overtired, training harder usually backfires.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am trying to separate being disciplined from being too hard on myself.
portuguese: Estou a tentar distinguir entre ser disciplinado e ser demasiado duro comigo.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR deesh-teen-GEER en-tr sair dees-see-plee-NAH-doo ee sair deh-mah-ZYAH-doo DOO-roo kon-TEE-goo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nem sempre é fácil, mas estou a tentar distinguir entre ser disciplinado e ser demasiado duro comigo.
exampleSentences.english: It is not always easy, but I am trying to separate being disciplined from being too hard on myself.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I sleep better when I get some daylight and movement during the day.
portuguese: Durmo melhor quando apanho alguma luz do dia e me mexo durante o dia.
pronunciationNote: DOOR-moo meh-LYOR KWAN-doo ah-PAH-nyoo al-GOO-mah looz doo DEE-ah ee m MEH-shoo door-AN-t oo DEE-ah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se fico fechado em casa, noto a diferença; durmo melhor quando apanho alguma luz do dia e me mexo durante o dia.
exampleSentences.english: If I stay indoors, I notice the difference; I sleep better when I get some daylight and movement during the day.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I have realised that doing something small is better than doing nothing.
portuguese: Percebi que fazer alguma coisa pequena é melhor do que não fazer nada.
pronunciationNote: pehr-seh-BEE k fah-ZAIR al-GOO-mah KOY-zah peh-KEH-nah eh meh-LYOR doo k nown fah-ZAIR NAH-dah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nos dias mais ocupados, percebi que fazer alguma coisa pequena é melhor do que não fazer nada.
exampleSentences.english: On busier days, I have realised that doing something small is better than doing nothing.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I want to build strength without ignoring mobility.
portuguese: Quero ganhar força sem ignorar a mobilidade.
pronunciationNote: KEH-roo gan-YAR FOR-sah seng eeg-noh-RAR ah moh-bee-lee-DAH-d

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim, o ideal é quero ganhar força sem ignorar a mobilidade.
exampleSentences.english: For me, the ideal is to build strength without ignoring mobility.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: The hardest part is usually starting, not the session itself.
portuguese: A parte mais difícil costuma ser começar, não o treino em si.
pronunciationNote: ah PAR-t mysh dee-FEE-seel koosh-TOO-mah sair koh-meh-SAR, nown oo TRAY-noo eng see

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando penso demasiado, a parte mais difícil costuma ser começar, não o treino em si.
exampleSentences.english: When I overthink it, the hardest part is usually starting, not the session itself.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I need to stop treating rest as if it were wasted time.
portuguese: Preciso de deixar de tratar o descanso como se fosse tempo perdido.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d day-SHAR d trah-TAR oo desh-KAN-soo KOH-moo s FOH-s tempo pehr-DEE-doo
grammarFocus: deixar de + infinitive and imperfect subjunctive

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para treinar melhor a longo prazo, preciso de deixar de tratar o descanso como se fosse tempo perdido.
exampleSentences.english: To train better in the long term, I need to stop treating rest as if it were wasted time.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I feel noticeably better when my day has some structure to it.
portuguese: Sinto-me claramente melhor quando o meu dia tem alguma estrutura.
pronunciationNote: SEEN-too-m klah-rah-MEN-t meh-LYOR KWAN-doo oo may-oo DEE-ah teng al-GOO-mah esh-troo-TOO-rah
notes: Useful for talking about routine and wellbeing.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo que não seja rígida, sinto-me claramente melhor quando o meu dia tem alguma estrutura.
exampleSentences.english: Even if it is not rigid, I feel noticeably better when my day has some structure to it.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I want habits that I can maintain even when life gets busy.
portuguese: Quero hábitos que consiga manter mesmo quando a vida fica mais ocupada.
pronunciationNote: KEH-roo AH-bee-toosh k kon-SEE-gah man-TAIR MAY-zmoo KWAN-doo ah VEE-dah FEE-kah mysh oh-koo-PAH-dah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não me interessam planos impossíveis; quero hábitos que consiga manter mesmo quando a vida fica mais ocupada.
exampleSentences.english: Impossible plans do not interest me; I want habits that I can maintain even when life gets busy.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I can feel the difference between being pleasantly tired and completely drained.
portuguese: Consigo sentir a diferença entre estar agradavelmente cansado e ficar completamente de rastos.
pronunciationNote: kon-SEE-goo sen-TEER ah dee-feh-REN-sah en-tr esh-TAR ah-grah-dah-vel-MEN-t kan-SAH-doo ee fee-KAR kom-pleh-tah-MEN-t d RRAH-shtoosh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Com o tempo, consigo sentir a diferença entre estar agradavelmente cansado e ficar completamente de rastos.
exampleSentences.english: With time, I can feel the difference between being pleasantly tired and completely drained.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I benefit more from consistency than from occasional intense effort.
portuguese: Beneficio mais da consistência do que de esforços intensos ocasionais.
pronunciationNote: beh-neh-FEE-see-oo mysh dah kon-seesh-TEN-see-ah doo k d esh-FOR-soosh een-TEN-soosh oh-kah-zee-oh-NAISH
notes: Useful for mature reflections on training.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ao fim de algum tempo, percebi que beneficio mais da consistência do que de esforços intensos ocasionais.
exampleSentences.english: After some time, I realised that I benefit more from consistency than from occasional intense effort.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am still learning how to pace myself properly.
portuguese: Ainda estou a aprender a gerir bem o meu ritmo.
pronunciationNote: een-DAH esh-TOH ah ah-prehn-DAYR ah zheh-REER beng oo may-oo REET-moo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quer no trabalho quer no exercício, ainda estou a aprender a gerir bem o meu ritmo.
exampleSentences.english: Both at work and in exercise, I am still learning how to pace myself properly.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: What helps me most is keeping things simple enough to repeat.
portuguese: O que mais me ajuda é manter as coisas suficientemente simples para repetir.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh m ah-ZHOO-dah eh man-TAIR az KOY-zash soo-fee-see-en-teh-MEN-t SEEM-plesh PAH-rah rreh-peh-TEER

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de procurar o plano perfeito, o que mais me ajuda é manter as coisas suficientemente simples para repetir.
exampleSentences.english: Instead of looking for the perfect plan, what helps me most is keeping things simple enough to repeat.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I notice that my mood improves when I spend less time indoors.
portuguese: Noto que o meu humor melhora quando passo menos tempo dentro de casa.
pronunciationNote: NOH-too k oo may-oo oo-MOR meh-LYOH-rah KWAN-doo PAH-soo MEN-oosh TEM-poo DEN-troo d KAH-zah
notes: Useful for talking about mood and environment.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Principalmente no inverno, noto que o meu humor melhora quando passo menos tempo dentro de casa.
exampleSentences.english: Especially in winter, I notice that my mood improves when I spend less time indoors.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I would like to be stronger without feeling obsessed by it.
portuguese: Gostava de ser mais forte sem ficar obcecado com isso.
pronunciationNote: goosh-TAH-vah d sair mysh FOR-t seng fee-KAR ob-seh-KAH-doo kong EE-soo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quero melhorar, mas gostava de ser mais forte sem ficar obcecado com isso.
exampleSentences.english: I want to improve, but I would like to be stronger without feeling obsessed by it.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: My energy dips sharply if I skip meals or sleep badly.
portuguese: A minha energia cai bastante se salto refeições ou durmo mal.
pronunciationNote: ah MEE-nyah eh-nehr-ZHEE-ah kaih bash-TAN-t s SAL-too rreh-fay-SOYNH ow DOOR-moo mahl
notes: Useful for talking about basic self-care.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Já sei por experiência que a minha energia cai bastante se salto refeições ou durmo mal.
exampleSentences.english: I already know from experience that my energy dips sharply if I skip meals or sleep badly.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am trying to listen to my body instead of ignoring early warning signs.
portuguese: Estou a tentar ouvir o meu corpo em vez de ignorar os primeiros sinais de alerta.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR oo-VEER oo may-oo KOR-poo eng vesh d eeg-noh-RAR oosh pree-MAI-roosh see-NAISH d ah-LAIR-tah
notes: Useful for injury prevention and recovery.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para não piorar, estou a tentar ouvir o meu corpo em vez de ignorar os primeiros sinais de alerta.
exampleSentences.english: So that it does not get worse, I am trying to listen to my body instead of ignoring early warning signs.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I recover more slowly if stress has been building up for days.
portuguese: Recupero mais devagar se o stress se tiver acumulado durante dias.
pronunciationNote: rreh-koo-PEH-roo mysh deh-vah-GAR s oo strehs s tee-VAIR ah-koo-moo-LAH-doo door-AN-t DEE-ash
notes: Useful for linking stress and recovery.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo com treino leve, recupero mais devagar se o stress se tiver acumulado durante dias.
exampleSentences.english: Even with light training, I recover more slowly if stress has been building up for days.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: The goal is to feel better overall, not to chase extremes.
portuguese: O objetivo é sentir-me melhor no geral, não andar atrás de extremos.
pronunciationNote: oo ob-zheh-TEE-voo eh sen-TEER-m meh-LYOR noo zheh-RAL, nown an-DAR ah-TRASH d esh-TREH-moosh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim, o objetivo é sentir-me melhor no geral, não andar atrás de extremos.
exampleSentences.english: For me, the goal is to feel better overall, not to chase extremes.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I have more motivation when the plan feels flexible rather than rigid.
portuguese: Tenho mais motivação quando o plano parece flexível em vez de rígido.
pronunciationNote: TEN-yoo mysh moh-tee-vah-SOWN KWAN-doo oo PLAH-noo pah-REH-s flex-EE-vel eng vesh d REE-zhee-doo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sei que sou mais constante assim: tenho mais motivação quando o plano parece flexível em vez de rígido.
exampleSentences.english: I know I am more consistent like that: I have more motivation when the plan feels flexible rather than rigid.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I need to pay attention to the habits around exercise, not just the workout itself.
portuguese: Preciso de prestar atenção aos hábitos à volta do exercício, e não só ao treino em si.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d presh-TAR ah-ten-SOWN owz AH-bee-toosh ah VOL-tah doo eh-zehr-SEE-see-oo, ee nown soh ow TRAY-noo eng see

exampleSentences.portuguese: Dormir, comer e organizar o dia contam muito, por isso preciso de prestar atenção aos hábitos à volta do exercício, e não só ao treino em si.
exampleSentences.english: Sleeping, eating and organising the day matter a lot, so I need to pay attention to the habits around exercise, not just the workout itself.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am at my best when I balance movement, sleep, food and downtime.
portuguese: Estou no meu melhor quando equilibro movimento, sono, alimentação e descanso.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH noo may-oo meh-LYOR KWAN-doo eh-kee-LEE-broo moo-vee-MEN-too, SOH-noo, ah-lee-men-tah-SOWN ee desh-KAN-soo
notes: Useful for summing up wellbeing priorities.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ao longo da semana, estou no meu melhor quando equilibro movimento, sono, alimentação e descanso.
exampleSentences.english: Over the week, I am at my best when I balance movement, sleep, food and downtime.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: If I neglect the basics, the rest tends to unravel.
portuguese: Se descuro o essencial, o resto costuma desfazer-se.
pronunciationNote: s deesh-KOO-roo oo esh-sen-see-AL, oo RRESH-too koosh-TOO-mah dezh-fah-ZAIR-s
grammarFocus: conditional with se and reflexive ending
notes: Useful for talking about basic routines.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sono, comida e descanso são a base; se descuro o essencial, o resto costuma desfazer-se.
exampleSentences.english: Sleep, food and rest are the foundation; if I neglect the basics, the rest tends to unravel.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I would like to train in a way that leaves me feeling more capable, not just exhausted.
portuguese: Gostava de treinar de uma forma que me deixasse mais capaz, e não apenas exausto.
pronunciationNote: goosh-TAH-vah d trey-NAR d OO-mah FOR-mah k m day-SHAH-s mysh kah-PAHZ, ee nown ah-peh-NASH eh-ZOWS-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: No fundo, gostava de treinar de uma forma que me deixasse mais capaz, e não apenas exausto.
exampleSentences.english: At the end of the day, I would like to train in a way that leaves me feeling more capable, not just exhausted.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I need habits that support my energy instead of draining it.
portuguese: Preciso de hábitos que apoiem a minha energia em vez de a gastarem.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d AH-bee-toosh k ah-POY-eng ah MEE-nyah eh-nehr-ZHEE-ah eng vesh d ah gash-TAH-reng

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quero simplificar a rotina: preciso de hábitos que apoiem a minha energia em vez de a gastarem.
exampleSentences.english: I want to simplify the routine: I need habits that support my energy instead of draining it.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: The challenge is not knowing what to do, but doing it regularly enough to matter.
portuguese: O desafio não é saber o que fazer, mas fazê-lo com regularidade suficiente para fazer diferença.
pronunciationNote: oo deh-zah-FEE-oo nown eh sah-BER oo k fah-ZAIR, mash fah-ZAY-loo kong rreh-goo-lah-ree-DAH-d soo-fee-see-EN-t PAH-rah fah-ZAIR dee-feh-REN-sah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Já sei a teoria: o desafio não é saber o que fazer, mas fazê-lo com regularidade suficiente para fazer diferença.
exampleSentences.english: I already know the theory: the challenge is not knowing what to do, but doing it regularly enough to matter.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am trying to make healthy choices feel normal rather than forced.
portuguese: Estou a tentar fazer com que escolhas saudáveis pareçam normais, e não forçadas.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ten-TAR fah-ZAIR kong k esh-KOYL-yash sow-DAH-vays pah-REH-sang nor-MAISH, ee nown for-SAH-dash

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para durar, estou a tentar fazer com que escolhas saudáveis pareçam normais, e não forçadas.
exampleSentences.english: To make it last, I am trying to make healthy choices feel normal rather than forced.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: The more overloaded I feel, the more I need simple routines that ground me.
portuguese: Quanto mais sobrecarregado me sinto, mais preciso de rotinas simples que me deem estabilidade.
pronunciationNote: KWAN-too mysh soh-breh-kah-RREH-gah-doo m SEEN-too, mysh preh-SEE-zoo d rroh-TEE-nash SEEM-plesh k m DAY-eng esh-tah-bee-lee-DAH-d
notes: Useful for talking about structure under stress.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nos períodos piores, quanto mais sobrecarregado me sinto, mais preciso de rotinas simples que me deem estabilidade.
exampleSentences.english: In the harder periods, the more overloaded I feel, the more I need simple routines that ground me.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I do better when I think in terms of routines, not all-or-nothing results.
portuguese: Corro melhor quando penso em rotinas, e não em resultados de tudo ou nada.
pronunciationNote: KOH-rroo meh-LYOR KWAN-doo PEN-soo eng rroh-TEE-nash, ee nown eng rreh-zool-TAH-doosh d TOO-doo ow NAH-dah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para não desistir, corro melhor quando penso em rotinas, e não em resultados de tudo ou nada.
exampleSentences.english: So that I do not give up, I do better when I think in terms of routines, not all-or-nothing results.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I would like to feel more at ease in my body, not just fitter.
portuguese: Gostava de me sentir mais à vontade no meu corpo, e não apenas em melhor forma.
pronunciationNote: goosh-TAH-vah d m sen-TEER mysh ah von-TAH-d noo may-oo KOR-poo, ee nown ah-peh-NASH eng meh-LYOR FOR-mah
notes: Useful for body confidence and wellbeing.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim isso conta muito: gostava de me sentir mais à vontade no meu corpo, e não apenas em melhor forma.
exampleSentences.english: For me that matters a lot: I would like to feel more at ease in my body, not just fitter.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I am gradually learning which habits actually make a difference for me.
portuguese: Estou a aprender aos poucos quais são os hábitos que realmente fazem diferença para mim.
pronunciationNote: esh-TOH ah ah-prehn-DAYR owsh POH-koosh kways sown ooz AH-bee-toosh k rreh-al-MEN-t FAH-zeng dee-feh-REN-sah PAH-rah meeng

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nem tudo funciona comigo, por isso estou a aprender aos poucos quais são os hábitos que realmente fazem diferença para mim.
exampleSentences.english: Not everything works for me, so I am gradually learning which habits actually make a difference for me.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I need to accept that some days call for movement and others call for rest.
portuguese: Preciso de aceitar que alguns dias pedem movimento e outros pedem descanso.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d ah-say-TAR k al-GOONSH DEE-ash PEH-deng moo-vee-MEN-too ee OH-troosh PEH-deng desh-KAN-soo
notes: Useful for a balanced view of training.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de forçar sempre, preciso de aceitar que alguns dias pedem movimento e outros pedem descanso.
exampleSentences.english: Instead of always forcing it, I need to accept that some days call for movement and others call for rest.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: What matters most is having enough energy for everyday life.
portuguese: O que mais importa é ter energia suficiente para o dia a dia.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh eem-POR-tah eh tair eh-nehr-ZHEE-ah soo-fee-see-EN-t PAH-rah oo DEE-ah ah DEE-ah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mais do que números ou metas, o que mais importa é ter energia suficiente para o dia a dia.
exampleSentences.english: More than numbers or targets, what matters most is having enough energy for everyday life.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I feel more resilient when I look after the basics consistently.
portuguese: Sinto-me mais resistente quando cuido do essencial com consistência.
pronunciationNote: SEEN-too-m mysh rreh-zeesh-TEN-t KWAN-doo koo-EE-doo doo esh-sen-see-AL kong kon-seesh-TEN-see-ah
notes: Useful for summing up a healthy routine.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não é perfeito, mas sinto-me mais resistente quando cuido do essencial com consistência.
exampleSentences.english: It is not perfect, but I feel more resilient when I look after the basics consistently.

subject: Body, Exercise & Wellbeing
english: I know the process is gradual, but I can already feel the benefits.
portuguese: Sei que o processo é gradual, mas já consigo sentir os benefícios.
pronunciationNote: SAY k oo proh-SEH-soo eh grah-doo-AL, mash zhah kon-SEE-goo sen-TEER oosh बेह-neh-FEE-see-oosh
notes: Useful for ending on a positive, reflective note.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda tenho caminho pela frente, mas sei que o processo é gradual e já consigo sentir os benefícios.
exampleSentences.english: I still have a way to go, but I know the process is gradual and I can already feel the benefits.
